notes.title: Arch Rivals Verified on Deck!
notes.content:
Steam recently reviewed Arch Rivals and it has been verified on Steam Deck! For the best experience, we recommend connecting your Steam Deck to an external display and playing with 2 wireless controllers.

Thank you to everyone who's played Arch Rivals since it launched and I hope you try it out on Deck! If you encounter any issues (whether that's on Deck or not) then please contact us and we'd love to get it sorted.
